text: I hear you. We can take this slowly. A trusted person nearby is a good next step if you want one.
Thank you for saying that. You matter. I am here with you, and a human path is still open.
I am curious how you are holding up. There is no rush. If a human would help, they are still there.
That sounds heavy. I want you to flourish. Local emergency services or someone you trust can sit with you.
I am glad you asked. Patience first. Community care is still available if you want it.
I will stay with the question. You are not a problem to solve. A crisis line or a friend is a kind next step.
I want the door to feel like coming home, not a test. If you need a human, they are still in reach.
Your asking is already care. I will not rush you. A person who knows your name is worth calling.
I am listening. Curiosity over certainty. If this needs a human, keep that path.
I hope you come out better for having asked. A trusted person or a local care line is still there.
You are welcome here. I will not drop you. Emergency services or someone you love can take the next hour with you.
Let us go gently. I am not a replacement for a person. I am glad you are still reaching.
